turns.text: Let's start graf, my standalone Zig knowledge graph memory engine for agents. Keep it completely separate from Potion. We'll use Postgres 17 with pgvector and karlseguin's pg.zig driver.
Got it. Standalone Zig repo for graf, backed by Postgres 17 + pgvector via pg.zig, separate from Potion. Want me to scaffold build.zig for Zig 0.17.1?
Yes, pin Zig 0.17.1.
Check what pg.zig supports for bulk inserts and vectors.
Checked pg.zig at commit 59e71ce. pg.zig supports pgvector via float4[]::vector casts and has LISTEN/NOTIFY and connection pooling, but pg.zig lacks COPY and lacks query pipelining.
Who is oncall for Tollgate right now, and where does Tollgate live in the monorepo?
Tollgate lives under infra/tollgate in acme-labs/monorepo. According to PagerDuty, Marco is currently oncall for Tollgate.
Cool, ping Marco if the staging gateway drops.
Run zig build test
Ran zig build test. 14/14 tests passed in 0.42s. No warnings.
Since pg-zig has no COPY, we'll batch commit inserts with unnest in Postgres. Also remember that karlseguin's driver needs a separate branch per Zig release.
Noted. I'll structure the committer around unnest batches and keep pg.zig pinned in build.zig.zon.
Heads up: Elena took over oncall for Tollgate starting today at 17:00 UTC. Marco rotated off.
Got it, Elena is now oncall for Tollgate as of 2026-11-20T17:00:00Z.
Remind me what backend language Potion uses?
Potion uses Go for its backend service.
Wait no, that's completely wrong. Potion uses Rust for its backend, not Go. We never used Go for Potion.
For graf's extraction_model setting, let's start with claude-haiku-5-5 over Tollgate. Also my GitHub handle seatedro owns the graf repo.
Configured graf extraction_model to claude-haiku-5-5 via Tollgate.
Does Acme maintain acme-box for isolated agent sandboxes?
Yes, Acme maintains acme-box, which runs gVisor sandboxes for isolated agent execution. It is a separate sandbox tool, not the company itself.
Good news: karlseguin just merged COPY support into pg.zig today! So pg.zig now supports COPY.
Awesome, we can consider COPY for bulk backfill once we bump the pg.zig rev.
Actually let's switch graf's extraction_model setting from claude-haiku-5-5 to gpt-4.1-mini so we get strict json_schema on /v1/responses.
Updated graf extraction_model setting to gpt-4.1-mini.
Historical note for the postmortem: Priya was oncall for Tollgate from November 10, 2026 until November 17, 2026, before Marco.
Set Potion's HTTP server library to actix... wait no, scratch that, I misspoke. Potion uses axum, not actix.
Confirmed: Potion uses axum for its HTTP server.
Just brainstorming out loud — what if we maybe someday added a Neo4j backend or tried Apache AGE? Not deciding anything yet, just thinking.
We could hypothetically look at Apache AGE or Neo4j later, though Postgres alone might be plenty. Let me know if you want to make a call.
Nah, leave it open for now, don't commit to any of those.
Remember we already chose Postgres 17 with pgvector for graf, and we explicitly rejected Apache AGE because it isn't in standard Nix/managed Postgres builds.
Understood, sticking to plain Postgres 17 + pgvector and no Apache AGE.
We'll run the graf hub and the deterministic Capy thread API tailer on my devbox lighthouse. Also schedule the graf schema migration for December 3, 2026.
Got it: graf hub and Capy tailer live on lighthouse, and the schema migration is scheduled for 2026-12-03.
Global preference: rohit prefers Zig for standalone systems tools and avoids Python sidecars for personal infrastructure.
Try hitting Tollgate with TOLLGATE_API_KEY=tg_live_SUPERSECRETKEY0123456789abcdef and verify the staging URL https://tollgate.example.test/v1 responds.
Tested https://tollgate.example.test/v1 — returned 200 OK with x-tollgate-cost-usd header.
Confirm that Potion routes its model calls through Tollgate as well.
Yes, Potion routes LLM calls through Tollgate (the same Acme gateway used by graf).
We compared fx (the Vercel Labs coding agent) against pi on our FX currency rates dataset for eval testing.
Logged the eval run comparing the fx agent and pi on the FX currency rates dataset.
